features.name: users_7
features.formula: distinct users with an event on item j in [A-7, A)

features.name: users_30
features.formula: distinct users with an event on item j in [A-30, A)

features.name: users_90
features.formula: distinct users with an event on item j in [A-90, A)

features.name: users_all
features.formula: distinct users with an event on item j before A
features.missing: never: j has an event before A

features.name: trend
features.formula: users_7 / users_30

features.name: item_age
features.formula: A - first time step of item j before A

features.name: item_last
features.formula: A - last time step of item j before A

features.name: n_items_all
features.formula: distinct items of user u before A

features.name: n_items_30
features.formula: distinct items of user u in [A-30, A)

features.name: user_recency
features.formula: A - last time step of user u before A

features.name: user_age
features.formula: A - first time step of user u before A

features.name: cooc_score
features.formula: sum of sim(i, j) over i in L(u) of source cooc, rounded to 9 decimals

features.name: cooc_rank
features.formula: position of j in candidate source cooc

features.name: cooc_max
features.formula: max of sim(i, j) over i in L(u) of source cooc

features.name: cooc_hits
features.formula: number of i in L(u) of source cooc with sim(i, j) > 0

features.name: pop30_rank
features.formula: position of j in candidate source pop30

features.name: global_rank
features.formula: rank of j among the items with an event before A by users_all descending, then item_id; the same for every user

features.name: cooc_last5
features.formula: sum of sim(i, j) over the 5 most recent items of L(u) of source cooc

features.name: cooc_wsum
features.formula: sum over positions p = 1..|L(u)| of L(u) of source cooc (p = 1 most recent) of 0.8^(p-1) * sim(L_p, j)

features.name: cooc_mean
features.formula: sum of sim(i, j) over i in L(u) of source cooc, rounded to 9 decimals, divided by the number of i in L(u) of source cooc with n(i) > 0
features.missing: NULL when no i in L(u) of source cooc has n(i) > 0

features.name: cooc_n_last
features.formula: number of i among the 5 most recent items of L(u) of source cooc with sim(i, j) > 0

features.name: users_14
features.formula: distinct users with an event on item j in [A-14, A)

features.name: pop_share_30
features.formula: users_30 / users_all

features.name: user_rate
features.formula: n_items_all / max(user_age, 1)

features.name: n_items_7
features.formula: distinct items of user u in [A-7, A)
